description: RFBzero contains Python routines for zero-dimensional simulation of electrochemical cycling in redox flow batteries. The package contributors publish modules for the initial cell configuration, electrolyte properties, cycling protocols and optional degradation or species crossover. It models a user-defined cell without a geographic domain or fixed historical period. Simulation duration is specified by the user, and the zero-dimensional representation does not resolve spatial distributions within a cell. The README shows constant-current and combined constant-current/constant-voltage examples and links further notebook documentation. Code is published on GitHub and distributed through PyPI under the MIT licence, permitting free reuse. Python 3.10 or later and SciPy are listed dependencies. Limitations include the lumped cell representation and the need to supply appropriate kinetic and degradation parameters. The results can inform storage-component assumptions in infrastructure energy studies, although the package is not itself a grid-dispatch model. Related record model-pypsa models energy networks where storage performance assumptions may be used; no direct software interface was verified. The examples were inspected but not executed.
